candidate_scope: Collects complete A40r02 evidence, including failed checks. Product qualification, acceptance and conclusions are determined by the original records and main report; this collector does not claim product validation passed.
other_reports: preserved complete in bundle; not reclassified or summarized here

runs.candidate_scope: Collects complete A40r02 evidence, including failed checks. Product qualification, acceptance and conclusions are determined by the original records and main report; this collector does not claim product validation passed.
runs.negative_success_meaning: okay means the expected refusal was checked; not a successful file read

request_uniqueness.scope: logical schedule slots only; these call rows have no RPC/native request ID; response hashes are not request identities

resources.error_occurrence_scope: cells repeat accumulated errors; snapshot occurrences are not independent failures
resources.survivor_scope: only descendants the sampler observed; not a universal no-processes proof

rounds.reported_scope: controller and reaped local descendants for complete round, including warmup, rejection cases and shutdown; remote CPU excluded

waited_local_process_tree_cpu.scope: RUSAGE_CHILDREN deltas recorded after each original controller wait; whole rounds including startup, warmup, measured calls, negative cases and shutdown; remote CPU and the external sampler's CPU excluded
